title: Upstream marked solved: conjecture
claim: formal-conjectures tagged conjecture solved. Docstring while it was tagged open: Let $\zeta$ be a primitive $(2n+1)$-th root of unity. Then the permanent of the $2n \times 2n$ matrix $[m(j,k)]_{j,k=1..2n}$ is $a(n)/(2n+1) = ((2n)!!)^2/(2n+1)$, where $m(j,k)$ is $1$ or $(1+\zeta^{j-k})/(1-\zeta^{j-k})$ according as $j = k$ or not. - Zhi-Wei Sun, Dec 21 2021
